messages:
incident-bot: Page: HIGH SEV - runtime queue spike on us-east-1. error-rate 502s and long tail latencies. Pager: eng-oncall
sam.lee: ACK. pulling logs.
maya: seeing 5xx spike right after a deploy to runtime-rev. queue length on runtime-pool-7 jumped from 30->450, latency p95 12s. customer-facing errors for embeddings and generation.
sam.lee: grabbing runbook — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-queue
jun: not showing OOMs. seems like inflight limits exhausted + head-of-line. let's reduce max_inflight for gen jobs and enable soft_shed.
opsbot: Executing: PATCH /admin/runtime/configs/cluster/us-east-1
```json
{ "max_inflight": 120, "soft_shed_enabled": true, "inflight_timeout_ms": 25000 }
```
opsbot: Success. config applied to runtime-pool-7.
maya: applying temporary customer quota bump for high-tier tenants experiencing 502s: tenant-877 and tenant-992
sam.lee: command to bump quotas:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/adjust \
  -d '{"tenant":"tenant-877","delta_concurrency":20}'
```
opsbot: Quota updated for tenant-877 and tenant-992.
jun: also disabling streaming-delta feature flag for gen route to reduce per-request CPU spikes — flipping ff/streaming-delta -> off
carla: patching traffic-shaper: lower per-tenant token rate from 1200 -> 600 for free tier to free up capacity. executing now.
opsbot: traffic-shaper rules updated.
maya: runtime metrics look better: p95 down from 12s -> 4.2s within 3min, error rate down 70%.
sam.lee: customer-impact list: tenant-877 had 8% errors (now 0.5%), tenant-201 saw degraded streaming only but not generation.
carla: Support: sent targeted emails to tenant-877 and tenant-992, message templates in #support-templates. customers told ~10-15m mitigation window.
support-bot: ticket INC-2026-443 created and linked to customer outages.
jun: leave soft_shed on for 30m, will gradually increase max_inflight back to 200 after stabilization. also tune inflight_timeout_ms -> 20000 after 10m if stable.
sam.lee: noted. I'm doing a handoff to night oncall at 5032113300 — will post full mitigation summary then.
maya: rolling restart avoided. keeping an eye on KV caches — no evictions yet.
carla: postmortem checklist started: root cause suspect is regression in batching scheduler in rollout rev-2026-03-14. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
sam.lee: closing page in 15min if metrics hold. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. last update 5032109970
